description: This file defines the Root controller for the Coocook web application, implementing various actions such as index, homepage, dashboard, about, and internal methods for request handling and redirection. It manages request preprocessing, access control, and view rendering logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Root
classes.description: Controller class for handling root-level web requests in the Coocook application, extending Coocook::Controller and using Moose for object system.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Initializes request, enforces HTTPS redirection for non-secure requests, and sets up the request context.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Prepares common stash variables such as site name, user info, and URLs before handling specific actions.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Performs automatic pre-processing for each request, including session messages, access control, and setting up view variables.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the root URL ('/') and displays recipes of the day or redirects to dashboard or homepage based on user capabilities.

methods.name: homepage
methods.description: Displays the homepage with recent public recipes and projects.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Displays the user's projects and related information if the user is logged in.

methods.name: about
methods.description: Displays the about page with configured title.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes response rendering, handling access restrictions, security headers, and robots meta tags.

methods.name: _validated_redirect
methods.description: Validates and performs a redirect based on a 'redirect' query parameter, ensuring security.
